name: restify-vscode-e2e-tests
description: End-to-end Playwright tests for Restify VS Code extension

scripts.prebuild: cd .. && rm -rf dist && NODE_OPTIONS="--max-old-space-size=8192" npm run build && rm -rf test/screenshots
scripts.test: npm run prebuild && npx playwright test
scripts.test:headed: npm run prebuild && npx playwright test --headed
scripts.test:debug: npm run prebuild && npx playwright test --debug
scripts.test:ui: npm run prebuild && npx playwright test --ui
scripts.demo: npm run prebuild && npx playwright test specs/demo.spec.ts --project=vscode
scripts.demo:headed: npm run prebuild && npx playwright test specs/demo.spec.ts --project=vscode --headed
